ns0:g.ns0:text: D01 Where is uncertainty continuity documented?

ns0:text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Computed distribution of 23 paper–context assessments from 20 publications. Ribbon width = assessment count.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: S3 → S4: no assessed article in this selected set; it has no ribbon. This is not proof of absence in the wider literature.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Each assessment has exactly one status. Multiple contexts from one publication remain dependent observations.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f7f7f

ns0:g.ns0:text: Ribbons classify evidence records; they do not show physical material flow or measured transfer of uncertainty.
